endpoints.title: Create geofence
endpoints.description: Creates a new geofence in the current account.  You can describe the geofence in either of two formats: - Simple format: root-level `type`, `points`, and optional `width`. - GeoJSON-style format: root-level `geometry`.  Simple format coordinates use `[latitude, longitude]`. GeoJSON-style `geometry` coordinates use `[longitude, latitude]` and accept only `Polygon`, `Line`, and `Circle` geometry types. - GeoJSON `Polygon`: `coordinates` is one closed outer ring: `[[[lon, lat], ...]]`.   The first and last coordinates must be equal; holes are not supported. - GeoJSON `Line`: `coordinates` is an array of at least 2 `[lon, lat]` pairs and   `width` is the corridor width in meters. - GeoJSON `Circle`: `coordinates` is the center `[lon, lat]` and `radius` is in meters.  `group_name` is required. If the group does not exist, it is created under the account root group. `color` is optional and defaults to `#00FF00`; pass it as a HEX color such as `#FF0000`. `external_id` is optional and must be unique inside the account. Set `for_all` to `1` to grant all account users access to the created geofence and its group.

parameters.name: X-Node
parameters.description: User node used to route the request to the correct backend

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Simple-format geofence type. Use with `points`; values are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description:
Simple-format coordinates in `[latitude, longitude]` order.
Polygon: array of at least 3 points.
Circle: `[latitude, longitude, radiusMeters]`.
Line: array of at least 2 points.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Simple-format line width in meters. Used only when `type` is `line`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Zone name. It must be unique inside the selected group unless `external_id` is used.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Geofence display color in HEX format. Defaults to `#00FF00`.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Optional free-form geofence description.

parameters.name: group_name
parameters.description: Geofence group name. The group is created automatically if it does not exist.

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Optional external geofence identifier. Must be unique inside the account.

parameters.name: for_all
parameters.description: Set to `1` to grant all users in the account access to the new geofence and its group.

parameters.name: geometry
parameters.description:
GeoJSON-style geofence geometry. The API accepts only `Polygon`, `Line`, and `Circle`.
Coordinates are always `[longitude, latitude]`.

endpoints.title: Update geofence
endpoints.description: Updates the geometry and/or name of an existing geofence. All fields except `zone_id` are optional. The API updates only fields that are present in the request and leaves omitted fields unchanged, so you can update only `name`, only `color`, `name` and `color`, or geometry alone. Use either the simple `type`/`points` format or the GeoJSON-style `geometry` object from create. Do not mix both geometry formats in one request.

parameters.name: zone_id
parameters.description: Geofence ID

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: New name for the geofence (optional)

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: New geofence color in HEX format

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Simple-format geofence type. Use with `points`; values are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description:
Simple-format coordinates in `[latitude, longitude]` order.
Polygon: array of at least 3 points.
Circle: `[latitude, longitude, radiusMeters]`.
Line: array of at least 2 points.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Simple-format line width in meters. Used only when `type` is `line`.

parameters.name: geometry
parameters.description: Optional new geofence geometry. Use this to change type, coordinates, radius, or line width.
